name: Google Trends
measures: Search demand, the closest free proxy for what people actually want

name: The Lyst Index
measures: Quarterly ranking of the hottest brands and products from 160M+ shoppers' behaviour

name: StockX
measures: Resale transactions for sneakers, streetwear and accessories (Current Culture Index, Big Facts)

name: The RealReal
measures: Luxury resale demand and saved searches (annual Resale Report)

name: ThredUp Resale Report
measures: Secondhand market size and shopper behaviour, with GlobalData

name: Tagwalk
measures: Runway frequency: every look from every fashion week, tagged and counted

name: Launchmetrics
measures: Media Impact Value of brands and moments across press and social

name: Heuritech
measures: AI forecasts from millions of social images: predicted visibility growth per item, region and segment

name: Pinterest Predicts
measures: Annual predictions from ~600M users' searches; self-reported 88% hit rate over six years

name: Pantone Color Institute
measures: Seasonal runway colour reports and Colour of the Year

name: Première Vision Paris
measures: The leading fabric fair: mills show materials about 18 months before they reach stores

name: Pitti Filati
measures: The leading yarn fair: spinners' colour and fibre direction about 18 months ahead

name: WGSN × Coloro
measures: The industry's largest forecaster; public colour, macro and consumer releases (core platform is paywalled)

name: Future Snoops
measures: Trend forecaster (formerly Fashion Snoops); colour and macro forecasts

name: BoF × McKinsey State of Fashion
measures: Annual industry outlook from executive surveys and market data

name: Euromonitor International
measures: Global consumer trends from survey data across 40+ markets

name: WWD
measures: Fashion's trade paper of record: runway reviews and what buyers are ordering

name: FashionUnited
measures: B2B fashion news and season data round-ups

name: Style Arcade
measures: Retail analytics platform; runway-to-range reporting

name: Who What Wear
measures: Established runway and shopping trend reporting

name: Fashionista
measures: Runway, street style and industry reporting

name: Marie Claire
measures: Established fashion and jewellery trend reporting
